# Highest Position: integer

source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_71/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_71/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_71/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

source7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_71/training_7.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source6_71_2 and Source6_71_7 on Artist
df_2_7 = pd.merge(source2, source7, on="Artist", how="inner")

# Join Source6_71_0 and Source6_71_1 on Artist
df_0_1 = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Artist", how="inner")

# Join Source6_71_4 and Source6_71_6 on Artist
df_4_6 = pd.merge(source4, source6, on="Artist", how="inner")

# Join Source6_71_3 and Source6_71_5 on Artist
df_3_5 = pd.merge(source3, source5, on="Artist", how="inner")

# Join the two intermediate dataframes on Artist
df_left = pd.merge(df_2_7, df_0_1, on="Artist", how="inner")
df_right = pd.merge(df_4_6, df_3_5, on="Artist", how="inner")

# Final join on Artist
df_final = pd.merge(df_left, df_right, on="Artist", how="inner")

# Group by Artist and aggregate other columns by max (to handle duplicates and keep consistent values)
df_grouped = df_final.groupby("Artist", as_index=False).agg({
    "Year Inducted": "max",

    "Influenced": "max",

})

# Write the final output
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_71/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
